name: comment-composer
title: Comment composer
description: A comment box that stays one line until focused, then offers Cancel and Comment, sends with Cmd or Ctrl Enter and keeps the draft.
docs: value and onChange keep the text in your state, so a draft survives re-renders and route changes, and a box with text stays open; leave value out and it keeps its own. onSubmit receives the trimmed text and may return a promise: the button shows a spinner and keeps focus while it runs, the box clears when it resolves and goes back to its one line with the cursor still in it, and when it rejects the text is kept and an alert shows the error's message, or labels.failed. Comment stays disabled until there is text, Cmd or Ctrl Enter sends, Escape folds an empty box and Cancel throws the draft away. maxLength adds a count near the end, author gives the avatar, and disabled locks the box for a closed thread: say why in placeholder. It is a form of its own, so do not nest it in another form. labels carries every word.
